title: Stream-bound atomic JSON serialization before full allocation
description: Correctness/security review of icxb found that atomic_json._bounded_json_bytes calls json_bytes/json.dumps first and only checks len afterward. An oversized generated document can therefore allocate the complete encoded string and bytes before the configured artifact limit rejects it, defeating the memory-exhaustion portion of the output bound. Use JSONEncoder.iterencode with cumulative UTF-8 byte accounting (including the canonical newline), fail as soon as the limit is exceeded, preserve exact json_bytes canonical output, and add boundary/early-abort tests.
